# The Diets — Online Nutrition & Clinical Diet Consultations

> The Diets provides 100% online, 1-on-1 private video dietitian consultations led personally by clinical nutritionists Dt. Radha Mishra and Dt. Surbhi Kumari across India.

## Organization & Brand Identity
- **Brand Name:** The Diets
- **Tagline:** Your Health, Your Goals, Your Personalised Nutrition Journey (आहार शुद्धौ सत्त्वशुद्धिः)
- **Primary Website:** https://www.thediets.in
- **Service Model:** 100% Virtual / Online private video consultations + active WhatsApp follow-up support.
- **Service Area:** Pan-India (clients connect online from anywhere in India via private video link).
- **Core Philosophy:** Kitchen-first, home-cooked Indian meals. Zero starvation, no crash dieting, no mandatory exotic ingredients, no separate cooking from family meals.
- **Direct Contact:** 
  - Phone / WhatsApp: +91 92960 47483
  - Official Email: thediets4you@gmail.com
  - Booking: https://www.thediets.in/book

## Clinical Dietitians & Founders

### Dt. Radha Mishra
- **Role:** Founder | Clinical Nutritionist & Dietitian
- **Credentials:** B.Sc., M.Sc. in Clinical Nutrition, Certified Diabetes Educator (CDE), International Association of Distance-Learning Dietitians (IADWL)
- **Experience:** 5+ Years Clinical Experience
- **Clinical Specialisations:** Weight Loss & Sustainable Fat Loss, Type 1 & Type 2 Diabetes Management, Glycemic Control (HbA1c reduction), PCOS/PCOD Hormonal Care, Therapeutic Nutrition, Custom Indian Diet Frameworks.

### Dt. Surbhi Kumari
- **Role:** Co-Founder | Dietitian & Nutrition Professional
- **Credentials:** B.Sc., M.Sc. in Food and Nutrition
- **Experience:** 3+ Years Clinical Experience
- **Clinical Specialisations:** Lifestyle & Weight Management, Thyroid Health (Hypothyroidism & Hyperthyroidism), PCOS/PCOD Cycle Regularity, Gut & Digestive Comfort, Anti-inflammatory Diets.

## Core Clinical Nutrition Programs & Pricing
1. **First Clarity Session (30–45 Mins) — ₹699:**
   - Diagnostic 1:1 video consultation exploring medical reports, digestive symptoms, daily routine, kitchen logistics, and metabolic health history with starter roadmap.
2. **4-Week Rhythm Reset (1 Month) — ₹4,999:**
   - Four weekly 1:1 video review sessions, personalized weekly home-cooked Indian meal plans, and Mon–Sat WhatsApp checks. Paced for fat loss and habit stability.
3. **12-Week Sustained Care (3 Months) — ₹12,999:**
   - Twelve weekly 1:1 video sessions, progressive therapeutic meal plans, blood-work nutritional alignment, and priority WhatsApp access for PCOS, Thyroid, and long-term sustainable weight management.

## Consultation Workflow (How It Works)
1. **Share Enquiry:** Submit a short note through the booking form or WhatsApp (+91 92960 47483).
2. **Confirm Slot:** Schedule a convenient video consultation time; receive private video link.
3. **1-on-1 Video Session:** Comprehensive 45-minute discussion on lifestyle, food preferences, and routine.
4. **Tailored Plan & Follow-ups:** Receive clear written meal plan notes after each session, followed by review video consultations and WhatsApp check-ins.
